comment: Structural rules the Level Director must follow. Values are tunable by the designer without touching generator code.
modeOrderComment: Four-mode rotation A -> B -> C -> D -> A... Boundaries come from detected sections, not equal chunks.

transition.breatherBeatsComment: MIRROR of TUNING.transition.breatherBeats in src/tuning.ts. The runtime drops every activation in the last breatherBeats of a section before a mode change. The editor server re-reads the live value from src/tuning.ts at startup and injects it over this one, and warns if the two ever disagree -- this JSON value is only the offline fallback. Do not hand-edit without updating src/tuning.ts too.

filler.comment: When a section's bars are not an exact multiple of the chosen pattern lengths, the remainder is filled with the section's lowest-difficulty pattern at reduced intensity.
